# CRM: Covey & Lark

Date: 2025-05-06  
Account: Covey & Lark Retail  
Footprint: 9 distribution sites; 42 seats live since 2025-04-01  
Activity: Dispatch check-in

Good call, mostly about the morning receiving rush. The Easton team is using Pemberline Dock consistently now, though door 6 keeps getting selected for oversized deliveries that should go to door 8. Not a scheduling failure; the door labels look too similar when dispatch is moving quickly. They also asked whether the daily arrivals export could put carrier names ahead of appointment IDs. Fair request, honestly—the printed sheet is what the floor crew actually carries.

Next: Send annotated door-label screenshots, log the export request, and ask dispatch for one marked-up arrivals sheet. Also check whether the late-shift handoff still needs a separate printout.
